label: first input token is l (t=0)
explanation: Binary feature that fires only at step t=0 when the first original token is the letter l, at a constant magnitude of 1.093 every time. It fires on every such sequence: dev precision, recall and F1 are all 1.0. It does not fire on l at any later position (including repeated l in the original phase or l being copied back), on any other token at t=0, or on the delimiter or copy phases. Sequence length, digit count and later tokens have no effect on whether it fires or how strongly.
